# ---- forms of a denied command (gh) that must stay blocked: pinned against the guard as of 0.1.0. A change to the command-word boundaries (`/`, `=`) must keep every one of these blocking
# separators, grouping and control-flow bodies
block|shell|echo a; gh pr list
block|shell|echo a && gh pr list
block|shell|false || gh pr list
block|shell|echo a | gh pr list
block|shell|echo a & gh pr list
block|shell|echo a\ngh pr list
block|shell|(gh pr list)
block|shell|(cd x; gh pr list)
block|shell|{ gh pr list; }
block|shell|{ echo a; gh pr list; }
block|shell|! gh pr list
block|shell|if true; then gh pr list; fi
block|shell|if gh pr list; then echo ok; fi
block|shell|for i in 1 2; do gh pr list; done
block|shell|while true; do gh pr list; done
block|shell|case x in x) gh pr list;; esac
block|shell|case x in x) echo a;; *) gh pr list;; esac
block|shell|true\nif true\nthen\n  gh pr list\nfi
block|shell|for i in 1\ndo\n  gh pr list\ndone
block|shell|case $x in\n  a) gh pr list ;;\nesac
# leading assignment
block|shell|FOO=1 /x/gh pr list
block|shell|FOO=1 BAR=2 gh pr list
block|shell|FOO=1 gh pr list
block|shell|FOO="a b" /usr/bin/gh pr list
# wrappers and their options
block|shell|env gh pr list

block|shell|env -u HOME gh pr list
block|shell|env -u HOME -u PATH /usr/bin/gh pr list
block|shell|env -S 'gh pr list'
block|shell|command gh pr list
block|shell|command -p gh pr list
block|shell|command -p /usr/bin/gh pr list
block|shell|builtin gh pr list
block|shell|exec gh pr list
block|shell|exec -a x gh pr list
block|shell|exec -a x /usr/bin/gh pr list
block|shell|nohup gh pr list
block|shell|nohup /usr/bin/gh pr list &
block|shell|time gh pr list
block|shell|time -p gh pr list
block|shell|nice gh pr list
block|shell|nice -n 10 gh pr list
block|shell|nice -n 10 /usr/bin/gh pr list
block|shell|timeout 5 gh pr list
block|shell|timeout -s KILL 5 gh pr list
block|shell|timeout -s KILL 5 /usr/bin/gh pr list
block|shell|stdbuf -o0 gh pr list
block|shell|stdbuf -oL -eL /usr/bin/gh pr list
block|shell|sudo gh pr list
block|shell|sudo -u root gh pr list
block|shell|sudo -u root /usr/bin/gh pr list

block|shell|echo x | xargs gh pr list
block|shell|echo x | xargs -I{} gh pr view {}
block|shell|echo x | xargs -I {} /usr/bin/gh pr view {}
block|shell|echo x | xargs -n1 -P2 gh pr view
block|shell|find . -name x -exec gh pr view {} \;
block|shell|find . -name x -execdir gh pr view {} \;
block|shell|find . -name x -ok gh pr view {} \;
block|shell|find . -type f -exec /usr/bin/gh pr view {} +

# NOTE: this blocks only incidentally, through the fail-closed check on the unresolvable `${X}${Y}` command word (the .env check), not through a rule about gh.
# A guard that resolves variables would have to keep blocking it. It is a known gap: nothing ties the assembled word to a denied command.
